t: 鲁昂向英格兰亨利五世投降，完成了对诺曼底的重新征服。
te: Rouen surrenders to Henry V of England, completing his reconquest of Normandy.
dz: 百年战争：鲁昂向英格兰亨利五世投降，完成了对诺曼底的重新征服。
de: Hundred Years' War: Rouen surrenders to Henry V of England, completing his reconquest of Normandy.

t: 一群激进的胡塞斯人杀死了布拉格市议会的7名议员.
te: A crowd of radical Hussites kill seven members of the Prague city council.
dz: 布拉格第一防守:一群激进的胡塞斯人杀死了布拉格市议会的7名议员.
de: First Defenestration of Prague: A crowd of radical Hussites kill seven members of the Prague city council.

t: 无所畏惧的约翰,勃艮第公爵被未来的法国查理七世的道平会的信徒所暗杀.
te: John the Fearless, Duke of Burgundy is assassinated by adherents of the Dauphin, the future Charles VII of France.
dz: 无所畏惧的约翰,勃艮第公爵被未来的法国查理七世的道平会的信徒所暗杀.
de: John the Fearless, Duke of Burgundy is assassinated by adherents of the Dauphin, the future Charles VII of France.

t: 百年战争:拉罗谢尔战役.
dz: 百年战争:拉罗谢尔战役.
de: Hundred Years' War: Battle of La Rochelle.
